title: ロボット設計演習Ⅱ
subtitle: Engineering Exercise for Robotics II
educationalGoal: (1) Learn mechanical design skills. (2) Learn mechanical drawing skills. (3) Learn how to use mechanical elements.
advice: This is a practical course on the design of a reduction gear. We will cover the following topics: 1. Design of spur gear 2. Design of input and output shafts 3. Bearing selection 4. 3D-CAD mechanical drawing
books: Textbooks: Methods of Machine Design, Morikita Publishing (in Japanese), Practice of Mechanical Design and Drafting, Suurikougakusha Co.,Ltd.(in Japanese), New JIS Mechanical Drawing, Morikita Publishing (in Japanese) Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Completion of Industrial Mechanics and Material Mechanics Basic knowledge of mechanical drawing

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the implementation of mechanical design, and use 3D-CAD drawings to explain design images.
Be able to carry out design calculations, such as basic design and detailed design of components.
Be able to create 3D-CAD machine designs that consider manufacturing methods, according to the machine drafting.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1)Understand the substance and shape of the design according to the instructions and prepare an easy-to-read assembly drawing by applying it to your own design conditions. (2)Understand design modeling and strength calculations according to the instructions. (3) Perform drawing of a 3D-CAD model of lower casing in addition to a 3D-CAD assembly model consisting of axes,gears,bearing and collar.
achievementLevels.standard: (1)Understand the content and shape of the design according to the instructions. (2)Understand design modeling and strength calculations according to the instructions. (3)Perform drawing of a 3D-CAD assembly model consisting of axes,gears,bearing and collar.

lessons.content: Outline of gear reducer. Outline of the design specifications. Outline of the design processes. Perform design calculations.
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A and Practice Understand the mechanism of gear reducer. Start the design calculations.
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Make sure that CAD software is ready for use. ・ Understand the relationship between the educational goals of the department and this subject. Review: ・ Progress the design calculations.

lessons.operation: Practice and Q&A Progress the design calculations.
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Development of calculation sheet for leading the design solutions. Review: ・ Perform design calculation based on the calculation sheet developed by each student.

lessons.operation: Practice and Q&A Progress the design calculations.
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Confirm the performance of calculation sheet. Review: ・ Perform design calculation based on the calculation sheet developed by each student.

lessons.operation: Practice and Q&A Progress the design calculations.
lessons.assignments: Preparation and Review: ・ Perform design calculation based on the calculation sheet .

lessons.operation: Practice and Q&A Finish the design calculations and submit the design solution.
lessons.assignments: Preparation and Review: ・ Perform design calculation based on the calculation sheet .

lessons.content: Review design solutions. Outline of 3D-CAD modelling of axes and gears.
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A and Practice Review the design calculations if necessary. Start drawing of 3D-CAD models of axes and gears.
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Review the design calculations. Review: ・ Perform drawing of 3D-CAD models of axes and gears.

lessons.content: Perform 3D-CAD modelling of axes and gears with reviewing design solutions.
lessons.operation: Practice and Q&A Progress the 3D-CAD modelling of axes and gears. Review the design calculations if necessary.
lessons.assignments: Preparation and Review: ・ Perform drawing of 3D-CAD models of axes and gears.

lessons.content: Perform 3D-CAD modelling of axes and gears with reviewing design solutions.
lessons.operation: Practice and Q&A Progress the 3D-CAD modelling of axes and gears. Review the design calculations if necessary.
lessons.assignments: Preparation and Review: ・ Perform drawing of 3D-CAD models of axes and gears.

lessons.content: Assembly 3D-CAD models. Assemble axes and gears.
lessons.operation: Practice and Q&A Assemble axes and gears models. Review the design calculations if necessary.
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Review the textbook of Mechanical Design to confirm the assembly function. Review: ・ Perform assembly of axes and gears.

lessons.content: Assembly 3D-CAD models. Assemble axes and gears.
lessons.operation: Practice and Q&A Assemble axes and gears models. Review the design calculations if necessary.
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Review the textbook of Mechanical Design to confirm the assembly function. Review: ・ Perform assembly of axes and gears.

lessons.content: Adjustment of dimensions and interferences. Review desing calculations.
lessons.operation: Practice and Q&A Confirm dimensions and interferences between axes and gears in a assembly model. Review the design calculations if necessary.
lessons.assignments: Preparation and Review: ・ Compare between calculation solutions and dimentions of 3D-CAD models made.

lessons.content: Perform 3D-CAD modelling of bearings and collars .
lessons.operation: Practice and Q&A Perform 3D-CAD modelling of bearings and collars to assemble with axes and gears.
lessons.assignments: Preparation and Review: ・ Compare between calculation solutions and dimentions of 3D-CAD models made.

lessons.content: Submit an assembly model. Outline of the design process of lower casing.
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A and Practice Submit an assembly model consisting of axes, gears, bearings and collars. Understand the locational relationship between the assembled model and a lower casing.
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Finish assembly of all 3D-CAD models. ・ Prepare the final achievement test.
Preparation: ・ Prepare the final achievement test.

Review: ・ Understand the results of achievement confirmation test, and confirm the achievement goal of this course. ・ Recognize your knowledge and abilities, including knowledge gaps, and restudy course materials as necessary.
